description: Warcraft Logs — Forever. Check Warcraft Logs (forever.warcraftlogs.com) for data on players of World of Warcraft: Forever (Forever-only; Classic and Retail are separate cogs). Characters are looked up by name + surname + region (Forever has no realms), a WCL character link or a WCL character ID. Fork of aikaterna's original WarcraftLogs cog.
install_msg:
Check out [p]help WarcraftLogsForever and set your WCL API key, available by signing into a WarcraftLogs account on their site and visiting the bottom of your settings page (the same `warcraftlogs` client is shared with the Classic and Retail cogs).
The bot needs Embed Links permissions before the relevant commands will be available for use in this cog.
This cog also comes with a font that is included in the bundled data, under the Apache 2.0 License, which can also be found in that bundled data directory.

This cog queries an outside service (Warcraft Logs API, forever.warcraftlogs.com) and needs Warcraft Logs API credentials.
short: Warcraft Logs — Forever: data for WoW: Forever players.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores data provided by users for the express purpose of redisplaying: a character name (or WCL character link/ID), a character surname and a region. It does not store user data which was not provided through a command. Users may remove their own content without making a data removal request. This cog does not support data requests, but will respect deletion requests.
name: WarcraftLogsForever
